> Reach International: Aerial work platforms (AWPs), access equipment and material handling equipment (MHE) for rental and sale in India. Tagline: Reaching All Heights.

## About

Reach International is an Indian industrial equipment company providing:
- Aerial work platforms: boom lifts, scissor lifts, vertical mast lifts, spider lifts, scaffolding
- Material handling equipment: forklifts, reach trucks, material lifts
- Services: equipment rental/hiring and equipment sales across India
